analyst.text: Memphis had their five-game win streak and franchise-record eight-game road streak snapped in Minnesota on Saturday, playing without Cameron Boozer (ankle) and Jerami Grant (calf), whose Monday status is unclear. Charlotte have lost four straight, Kon Knueppel is out at least four more weeks after re-straining his hamstring, and local coverage already talks of the season slipping away. The angle leans towards Memphis.
